originalTitle: AI YC interview with Gstack agents
summary: AI specialists that join your Google Meet and gives feedback Discussion | Link
content: Garry Tan's open-sourced gstack specialists — CEO, CSO, QA Lead, a YC-office-hours partner and 15 more — join your real Google Meet as voice bots with 3D avatars. They open in-persona, take turns, critique your shared screen out loud, and drop notes in chat. Free, MIT, and the brain is your own coding-agent session. Built on AgentCall.
chineseSummary: AI 专家加入您的 Google Meet 并提供反馈关联
chineseContent: Garry Tan 的开源 gstack 专家 - 首席执行官、CSO、QA 主管、YC 办公时间合作伙伴以及其他 15 名 - 以具有 3D 头像的语音机器人的身份加入您真正的 Google Meet。他们以个人身份打开，轮流发言，大声批评您的共享屏幕，并在聊天中留言。免费，麻省理工学院，大脑是你自己的编码代理会话。基于 AgentCall 构建。
